source.original_title: 05/13/2026 - Ethan John & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/13/2026 - Ethan John & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Undetermined

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Rep names her while referencing her handover notes: 'Well, Kim told me that you're quite straightforward.'

prospect.name: Ethan John
prospect.training_background: Has been going to the gym for a considerable time and describes himself as 'kind of lean'. Currently a paying Primal University customer — bought one month to trial it and had just finished a week-three workout. Follows Trevor's morning mobility and lymphatic drainage content online.

signals: Already training and lean, seeking skill acquisition rather than rescue: 'I've been working out for a decent amount of time. I'm like kind of lean, but I wanted to really learn how to...'
Wants to add a full movement repertoire: 'I at least want to have in my repertoire, like the entire kettlebell, the mace, all that stuff'
Already bought the low-tier product and is stepping up to ask for tailoring: 'I understand there's like Primal University and stuff like that, but I wanted a more tailored program'
Time-poor and work-dominated: 'I'm like really really busy with work honestly'
Confidence is low because the call terminated at 00:04:43 before baseline, goals, finances or occupation were reached

goals.text: Learn the full kettlebell and mace movement repertoire properly rather than improvising
Get a tailored programme with someone actually watching him, rather than the self-guided Primal University course
Lock in a short daily morning mobility routine — the reason he started following Trevor at all

pains.text: Has never found a morning mobility routine that fits: 'I've always tried to find like a five-minute mobility thing in the morning, and I've never found the right one or the perfect one'
Work leaves him almost no time — was up late the night before and took the call while walking on a treadmill
Self-guided course is not enough on its own; wants someone to see what he is doing

evidence: Recording ends mid-sentence at 00:04:43 with the rep saying 'Here's what I'm going to do.' — no resolution is on tape
Audio failed repeatedly throughout: 'Oh, you broke up, by the way. Still can't hear you.' and 'You've gone again, brother.'
No offer was presented, no price was discussed and no objection was raised
Counter-evidence toward a live opportunity: the prospect is an existing paying Primal University customer and explicitly asked for the upgrade — 'I wanted a more tailored program'
Counter-evidence toward a reschedule: he declined video and floated moving the call — 'if you could do in like 30 minutes or something maybe'
outcome.next_step: Unknown — the rep began stating a plan ('Here's what I'm going to do') and the recording cuts. A reschedule is the most likely intent given he had already offered one, but it is not on tape.

notable.note: This is a failed connection, not a sales conversation: roughly five minutes of audio and video failures with no discovery completed. It must not sit in a close-rate denominator as a loss. Worth chasing separately — the prospect is already paying for Primal University, asked unprompted for the tailored upgrade, and never got the conversation. The rep did the right thing pushing back on a treadmill call ('we like to make sure it's a face-to-face conversation'), but no reschedule is confirmed on tape.

quality.notes: Severe. The block from 00:00:58 to 00:02:01 is attributed entirely to 'Ethan John' but contains both sides of the exchange, including the rep's reschedule push ('is there a better time you want to reschedule for because we're kind of building out a game plan'). The 00:04:31 and 00:04:35 turns are also inverted. Roles resolved from content.
